mechanism_definition.inherited: DIN-inspired target-aware category/brand histories, behavior/time context, shared embeddings, masked-softmax pooling, normalized explicit field products, mean BCE and Adam under the frozen host recipe.
mechanism_definition.pairing: Aligned versus crossed normalized product context; crossed is an informative replacement, not a semantic information-null.
mechanism_definition.gradient_change: Inherited scale_half_tangent retains recipient tangent directions while reassigning inverse-norm scales by stable inverse-norm rank and half rotation within eligible histories. Scalar scale multiset and its first/second moments are preserved for those groups. This is donor reassignment, not multiplication of the whole gradient by one half.
mechanism_definition.provenance: memory://agent-r0029 mechanism_definition, memory://agent-r0012 ordering contrasts, registered configs and schema8 bounded checks. No source-level rederivation claimed in this phase.
mechanism_definition.none: No complete-row projection or magnitude intervention; the half-tangent product surrogate remains active in half cells.
mechanism_definition.forward_identity: Same fixed checkpoint full-versus-half product/logit checks are zero within each cell. Different trained checkpoints can predict differently.
mechanism_definition.historical_magnitude: Complete shared-row gradient G is scaled by ||P||/||G|| for a guarded projected target P. Preserving raw-gradient direction does not preserve Adam update direction.

observations.statement: All 88 committed own-arm receipts resolve and match the runtime/index:84 successes and four trace-v1 failures. Each success scores 3,234,051 validation impressions. Only declared seed 42 is observed; replay counts are not independent initializations.
Static, pooled-history and target-aware reference AUCs are 0.6050036145,0.6102261137 and0.6133619861. History is useful under this benchmark, without identifying a semantic bottleneck.
Round30 aligned half improves full by +0.0001204973277 AUC and -0.00003082365591 Logloss. Both executions succeed; parameters and declared recipe match.
Round29 crossed half improves full by +0.0004667050401 AUC and -0.0003271451568 Logloss. The direction is positive in both pairing contexts.

The common-implementation interaction (crossed half-minus-full) minus (aligned half-minus-full) is +0.0003462077124 AUC and -0.0002963215009 Logloss. It exactly reproduces the earlier descriptive mixed-source arithmetic.

Aligned half exceeds crossed half by +0.0012437529830 AUC and -0.0001256945697 Logloss; aligned full exceeds crossed full by +0.0015899606954 AUC and -0.0004220160707 Logloss. Half does not erase the observed pairing advantage.

Round30 aligned full exactly replays historical normalized-aligned AUC/Logloss/sample count/all 23 slice dictionaries. Aligned half replays round12 and observer-free round28 aggregates/slices. Source hashes differ and inference timings differ; state equality is unobserved.

Aligned half improves AUC in15/23 overlapping slices and loss in16/23. Empty-history and history1_16 regress on both metrics. Crossed half improves AUC in20/23 and loss in23/23; it still loses empty-history AUC. Slice benefits are not uniform.

Schema8 diagnostics in all four cells report the expected pairing/gradient flags, no observers/row intervention, zero sampled same-state forward discrepancies, finite logits, zero masked mass and empty summaries. Scope is 512 ordered validation impressions, including four empty histories and 60475 valid events; no natural floor/boundary events are sampled.

Aligned checkpoints report mean absolute own/donor scale changes 0.0674973 and 0.0670525, moment relative errors at most 2.312e-7, synthetic donor error 0 and synthetic VJP relative error 1.4383e-16. These are bounded candidate-supplied checks, not independent full-training derivative or optimizer measurements.

Aligned-half wall/train times exceed aligned-full by 2.4555/1.4001 seconds, with 902733312 versus 900373504 peak GPU bytes. Inference is 178645 versus 182643 examples/s. Batch 4096 p50/p95 is 21.360/22.152 versus 20.899/21.853ms including causal feature gathering. One timing pair establishes no efficiency advantage.

Historical magnitude AUC 0.6152795937 becomes 0.6149279139 on same-source/config exact17 replay. Round26 magnitude-minus-none is +0.0000243281 AUC; round27 is -0.0001685359. Retain positive and negative results; a repeatable magnitude increment is unestablished.

Latest knowledge-usage variant names, hashes and statuses match both round30 receipts; status is documented with no undocumented industry IDs. Declared source use is provenance, not causal proof of knowledge value.
